behaviors.behavior: Layer-1 context-loading read is bounded (20 most recent, one line each)
A decision-drop written in one worktree does not appear in a sibling worktree
An uncommitted drop is lost when its worktree is removed (accepted tradeoff)
A committed-then-merged drop survives worktree removal and is aggregated (producer -> worktree file -> commit -> merge -> consumer)
Group-F F5 arch-drift detective resolves decision-drops against project_root, not main
test_architecture_md_reflects_arch_impact.py's own drift-oracle resolves against project_root
An already-adopted project's stale blanket decision-drops/ ignore rule is RETRACTED on next self-heal, replacement rules added in the same pass
Retraction never touches a hand-written line outside the target's own managed marker block
F11 fails when a decision-drop is present in the working tree but absent from this iterate's own commit(s)
F11 SKIPs (not fails) when the directory is still gitignored in a project that hasn't self-healed yet
A drop whose file mtime predates the tracking cutoff is quarantined, not aggregated; freshness reads mtime, not the JSON date field
Quarantine is report-only under --dry-run
F6's decision-drop staging is glob-scoped to {run_id}_*.json, not the whole directory
